+def _route(policy, data):
+    required = data.get("required", [])
+    bits = {node: 1 << i for i, node in enumerate(required)}
+    full = (1 << len(required)) - 1
+    initial_mask = bits.get(data["source"], 0)
+    graph = [[] for _ in range(data["n"])]
+    for edge in data["edges"]:
+        graph[edge["u"]].append(edge)
+    # Each state retains the coupon count and requirement mask; earliest time
+    # dominates later times for the same state.
+    start_state = (data["source"], initial_mask, 0)
+    best = {start_state: data["start"]}
+    queue = [(data["start"], data["source"], initial_mask, 0)]
+    while queue:
+        time, node, mask, spent = heapq.heappop(queue)
+        state = (node, mask, spent)
+        if time != best.get(state):
+            continue
+        if node == data["target"] and mask == full and (policy["coupon_rule"] != "exact" or spent == data["coupons"]):
+            return {"arrival": time}
+        for edge in graph[node]:
+            depart = max(time, edge["open"])
+            if depart >= edge["close"]:
+                continue
+            durations = [(edge["duration"], spent)]
+            if spent < data["coupons"]:
+                duration = max(policy["minimum_duration"], edge["duration"] - edge.get("discount", 0))
+                durations.append((duration, spent + 1))
+            for duration, next_spent in durations:
+                arrival = depart + duration
+                if arrival > data["deadline"]:
+                    continue
+                nxt = edge["v"]
+                next_mask = mask | bits.get(nxt, 0)
+                next_state = (nxt, next_mask, next_spent)
+                if arrival < best.get(next_state, float("inf")):
+                    best[next_state] = arrival
+                    heapq.heappush(queue, (arrival, nxt, next_mask, next_spent))
+    return {"arrival": None}
+
